_comment: Implementation constants of the Tier A engine (src/biomark/{stats,en,arms,null,audit,pipeline}.py). NOT a design decision file: every DESIGN §F number is read from design_params.json / primary_endpoints.json / seeds.json; this file only holds numerical tolerances, solver limits, covariate coding and name maps the design leaves to the implementation (docs/impl_notes_pipeline.md). Loaded via biomark.params.

covariates._comment: Canonical covariate columns (pipeline.Data.cov). Design blocks are never dropped (DESIGN 5.3); droppable shared covariates are dropped per (g, d) by stats.shared_drops; gene covariates (own CN, EXPGATE) by stats.gene_cov_drops. reference = level that absorbs merged (< 2-line) levels; null = most frequent level in the fit rows.

tp53_derivation._comment: TP53 omitted when d derives from TP53 (any feature of these genes) or MDM2 amplification (DESIGN 5.3); symbols resolved to Entrez at run time

en.fidelity_sst: sum of squared held-out residualised target (FWL by training-fold coefficients)

subsamples.half_rule: within each pooled lineage, patients shuffled (subsample_seed) and alternately assigned to half a / b; complementary pair = (a, b)

audit.interaction_test: OLS F-test of d x lineage interaction terms over testable lineages (homoskedastic; secondary label input)

df_rule._comment: DESIGN 5.3 df_fallback_if_calibration_fails, triggered by tests/test_inference_calibration.py (n = 255, carrier SD x 2; results/deviations.csv). Binary d: df = min(n - rank(Z) - 2, carrier clusters - 1); continuous d: min(n - rank(Z) - 2, nu). The nu-based df and p stay as the logged sensitivity (df_nu, p_nu).
